decisions.reason: Although related to sustainability, a vegan superfood drink mix sits outside the firm's main industrial waste-to-energy and process-technology focus, so management would likely reallocate resources to more strategic technology ventures.

Modular waste-to-energy plant extensions fit the firm's established engineering and decentralized energy offering and are consistent with a growing German chemicals sector that supports R&D-led industrial innovation.
A waste oil to energy plant is strongly aligned with the firm's core capability in turning waste streams into energy, and its dedicated product page suggests enough strategic importance to continue.
A plastic waste to fuel plant is close to the firm's existing sustainable conversion technologies and matches its ambition to scale practical, cost-competitive environmental solutions.
